18:    WAKE have separate records and processes.

28: authorized work continues. Check completion only when reaching its next dependent

31: [hosted upgrades](cloud.md#publish-source-without-upgrading-records) to choose checks;
32: full history replay is a record-compatibility gate, not a universal UI gate.

35: compatibility code, archives or backups solely to preserve disposable development
36: data. Prefer a simple implementation; an explicitly selected installation can be

39: their controls remain separate from ordinary source or interface delivery.
